critical_code_review_comments: cache_refresh._prune_stale uses an ISO-string comparison on `created_at` ($lt cutoff_iso). Works as long as all rows are written with the same datetime.isoformat() format and tz suffix — currently true. If a future writer switches to BSON Date or a different tz-suffix, the lexicographic compare will silently break. Consider migrating cache rows to native BSON Date and querying with a real datetime.
server.py is 2350+ lines — recommend splitting admin/cron endpoints, guidance handlers, and PDF/Stripe handlers into separate routers per the >700-line guideline.
FastAPI startup/shutdown still uses deprecated @app.on_event — migrate to lifespan handlers (also keeps APScheduler shutdown cleaner).

schedule_monthly_refresh's _trampoline uses asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task — fine because AsyncIOScheduler runs in the event loop, but the fallback asyncio.run(_job()) will never execute and can be dropped.
